Officially Meri Jaan

Ye shahi khitaab pesh kiya jata hai
ko ye sab haq hamesha ke liye milte hain:
  • Hamesha suni jaogi. Tumhari har baat aur har raay meri sabse zaroori hai.
  • Roz celebration. Aaj ka din toh khaas hai hi, par party kabhi khatam nahi hogi.
  • Maharani wala treatment. Extra hugs, aur fries mein meri share bhi tumhari.
  • Hamesha chamko. Crown optional hai, muskaan zaroori.
  • Shartein: hamesha ke liye valid, wapas nahi hoga, kisi aur ko transfer nahi hoga.

Ek Chitthi Tumhare Naam

Hey ,

Mujhe ye sab bolna nahi aata, isliye ye page bana diya.

Jab se tum meri life mein aayi ho, sab kuch aur khoobsurat lagne laga hai. Tumhari hansi, tumhara gussa, tumhari chhoti chhoti baatein… mujhe sab kuch pyaara hai.

Main tumse bahut, bahut pyaar karta hoon. Sach mein. Tumhare bina ab sab kuch adhura sa lagta hai.

Itne time se saath hain hum, aur ab mere future ki har tasveer mein sirf tum ho. Isliye aaj main tumse kuch bahut khaas poochna chahta hoon…
